reviews.text: Kim has always given me the best natural results with my injections and is so gentle. Recently tried dermaplane and oxygen facial with Courtney and my face has never looked so plumped and hydrated. Love all the options they offer

I am loving my results from Morpheus 8 treatments! The fine lines, texture, and tone of my skin have really improved. I also appreciate that Kim has multiple numbing methods to help make me comfortable during treatment.

I have never been one to pamper myself until recently this year. I suffered from a stubborn case of malasma, my self esteem had diminished this summer especially since I wasn’t putting makeup on daily to go into the office.  The malasma started almost ten years ago with a few brown spots on my forehead. Throughout the years and a pregnancy, the melasma only got worse. I had seen several dermatologist where I was prescribed lighting creams. None of them made a difference. Over the counter creams were also a waste of money.

I met Kim in early August. She made me feel comfortable with her bedside manner. She had an aggressive  plan for the melasma that I  was more than comfortable with taking. The other providers saw me once and I would never see them again. Kim was invested in me! She wanted to see me every 3 weeks for in office treatments. Additionally, I was responsible for my at home treatments. I was diligent with my morning and evening treatments. I am a customer for life!

I’ve been bouncing around places for the year I’ve lived here but can’t seem to find someone knowledgeable (or they leave the place if they are decent and I lose them).  I found Kim on Instagram and actually won a prize in a contest she ran a few months ago.

I finally went in to get my prize and get some Botox. For the first time in the last 7 years I’ve been getting Botox has someone taken the time to explain to me why drooping happens and how to prevent it.  She took her time and made sure everything was thoroughly explained. She clearly knows her stuff!

reviews.text:
I really wanted to love this salon. The space is adorable, the staff was friendly, and I absolutely loved my nail tech. I also appreciate that they use less toxic products, which is so hard to find! Unfortunately my chrome nails started chipping the very next day, and by days three and four, several were peeling completely off. I spent my airplane ride overseas tearing them off so they would at least match.

When I reached out the first time, they kindly offered to fix them, but I live about an hour away and had gotten them done right before leaving for my trip. They suggested I file and reseal them at home, which I did since I have my own gel machine, but the chipping continued. I later requested a refund (minus the tip because my nail tech was amazing and sweet) since I knew I might have to have them redone on my trip. Although I appreciated the gesture, they only refunded me about $60 for the chrome portion. When my chrome nail completely lifted up, I emailed the salon one more time before boarding my flight overseas to let them know what happened on day four. I was surprised and disappointed when I didn’t hear back at all.

As someone who has worked in the beauty industry as a hairstylist for nearly 15 years, I know how much pride professionals take in their work, and I truly wanted this to be my new salon. But for nearly $200, I expected my nails to last more than a day or two. Sadly, I don’t think I’ll be returning, but I do hope they address this issue because the experience itself and the staff were lovely.
